title: Wipeout
wikitext:
Wipeout is a team mod/gametype/gamemode by [[Image:flag_us.gif]][[Dusty]], enabled by typing /wipeout on [[KTX]] servers from 1.41.
It is the QuakeWorld version of the Wipeout of Diabotical (game). It plays similarly to [[Clan Arena]]. ==Gameplay== Wipeout is a round based mode in which players spawn with a full loadout. Consecutive deaths increase a player's respawn time up to a maximum of 30 seconds, and a round is won when all enemy players are dead.
